principles: N1000-N11000 are carried forward unchanged from expert_0.5.0.
N12000 summarizes only N10000 same-player/same-role strict-past evidence already present in the parent engine.
ABOVE/BELOW/EQUAL counts are descriptive directions only and are never interpreted as good/bad fit.
Metric-role semantics such as cost, volume or efficiency are not assigned weights or favourability.
Evidence coverage is an exact fraction of evaluable N10000 signals out of the 24 catalogued signals, not a performance score.
No minimum-sample threshold, weighted score, percentile, cross-player ranking or tactical recommendation is introduced.
confidence=1.0 means deterministic execution of the synthesis rule, not calibrated fit probability.
